status: Frozen before recurrence controls or new public-fit selection; targeted post-outcome investigation, not independent validation.

source_routing.club: DUAL, release0/0, delayoff, direct reverb send50/0; brief late gaps give best release/delay attribution, original key-up unknown.
source_routing.ambient: DUAL, release30/22, active modulated delay and sends43/112; combined tail cannot isolate reverb.
source_routing.cotton: SINGLE, release39, delay send0, neutral damping; long17.25–21.75s tail gives conditional8.2–8.5s effective decay, current isolated target7.011s.

algorithm.filter: Causal2205-tap Hamming FIR bandpass80–640Hz at44100Hz, downsample21; add1102sample filter group delay and93sample engine delay once.
algorithm.seconds_clock: Stimulus time; burst ends.20s, so train starts.09s after input ends. Same operational ages as Club firstgap2.30s minus approximate2.21s key-up.
algorithm.fit: Shared real AR coefficients pooled across left/right of two noise-tail training supports. Normalize each complete training channel by its trainingRMS only for regression conditioning. SVD least squares rcond1e-10; no ridge or pole reflection.
algorithm.prediction: Initialize each sequence from only its final p training samples, then free-run over full.35s check; no check samples fed back, no gain/time fit.
algorithm.positive_control: Eight known complex-conjugate damped modes, fixed irregular100–600Hz frequencies andT60s1.2–4.1s; two independent initial states train and third heldout. Analytic release-oscillator versus modal-reverb interpretations give identical waveform.
algorithm.continuing_input_control: Add a fixed chirped input beginning after training; coefficients remain from pure training. This should challenge any no-input extrapolation, but predictable input could still pass.
algorithm.numerical_guard: Known eight-mode positive control order>=16 must free-run with waveform relativeRMS<1e-3. Actual FDN must predict every source/channel later RMS envelope within0.5dB at both50/100ms windows before this recurrence can inform public-data pole fitting.0.5dB is a discrimination target smaller than priorClub2.31dB gain-invariant drift, not a perceptual equivalence tolerance.
algorithm.hardware_branch: Do not fit new hardware poles/order/period in this tool. If actualFDN fails, stop; if it passes, propose a separate frozen firsttwo-gap/common-recurrence fit and third-gap holdout with coefficient/order unchanged. A successful recurrence never by itself identifies reverb versus source release or damping topology.

excluded_claims: No candidate parameter identification from a successful recurrence alone
